name: Hacked Light Omni-Tek Artillery Tank Armor

intro.text: Since the standard issue can only be worn by Omni-Tek personnel, several groups started to develop ways of enabling it to be worn by any faction.
Soon, not one, but two methods were developed which removed the OT restriction. Unfortunately both processes double the run speed handicap.
